In this very high standard race the first five broke Fred Norris' record, the first eighteen were inside AAA Grade I standards and the first thirty-seven (a third of the starters) were inside two hours.

He caught Gerry at Copse Hill and is reputed to have run up it faster than anyone before or since (or so Gerry thinks!) and went careering on to win in 1:48:50 -- 52 secs ahead of Gerry. Only Fred Norris had run faster.
